title: Social Page
description: A user-hosted page in a decentralized social network. Post to your own page; following, unfollowing and liking are cross-Thing effects that update both your page and the other person's page through a page-id parameter.

posts.title: Posts
posts.description: Posts on this page, each with an id and content.

followers.title: Followers
followers.description: Page ids that follow this page.

likedPosts.title: Liked Posts
likedPosts.description: Post ids this page has liked.

createPost.title: Create Post
createPost.description: Publish a post on this page. Post ids are assigned from a counter.

followUser.title: Follow User
followUser.description: Follow another page: add it to this page's following and add this page to its followers.
followUser.vre:effects: following' = following.append(pageUri); pageUri.followers' = pageUri.followers.append(this.id); output.success = true; output.followed = pageUri;

unfollowUser.title: Unfollow User
unfollowUser.description: Unfollow another page: remove it from this page's following and remove this page from its followers.
unfollowUser.vre:effects: following' = following.remove(pageUri); pageUri.followers' = pageUri.followers.remove(this.id); output.success = true; output.unfollowed = pageUri;

likePost.title: Like Post
likePost.description: Like a post on another page: record the post id here and raise that page's likesReceived.

pageUri.description: Page id whose post is liked.

likePost.vre:effects: likedPosts' = likedPosts.append(postId); pageUri.likesReceived' = pageUri.likesReceived + 1; output.success = true; output.liked = postId;
